'''Kendrick''' (Japanese: '''ケンオー''' ''Kenō'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}.

He first appeared in ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', where he participated in the [[Vertress Conference]] and was {{un|Cameron}}'s first opponent. He was shown to be a determined {{pkmn|Trainer}} who focused on the match, as he told Cameron to save his chatter for later. Kendrick continued to use {{m|Crush Claw}} on Cameron's {{p|Ferrothorn}} and initially had the upper hand. However, in ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he was soon defeated and eliminated from the tournament.
